verses.en: And it came to pass in Iconium, that they went both together into the synagogue of the Jews, and so spake, that a great multitude both of the Jews and also of the Greeks believed.
verses.pt: Em Icônio entraram juntos na sinagoga dos judeus e falaram de tal modo que creu uma grande multidão tanto de judeus como de gregos.
verses.en_web: In Iconium, they entered together into the synagogue of the Jews, and so spoke that a great multitude both of Jews and of Greeks believed.
verses.en_bbe: Now in Iconium they went together to the Synagogue of the Jews and gave such teaching that a great number of Jews and Greeks had faith.

verses.en: But the unbelieving Jews stirred up the Gentiles, and made their minds evil affected against the brethren.
verses.pt: Mas os judeus incrédulos excitaram e irritaram os ânimos dos gentios contra os irmãos.
verses.en_web: But the disbelieving Jews stirred up and embittered the souls of the Gentiles against the brothers.
verses.en_bbe: But those Jews who had not the faith, made the minds of the Gentiles bitter against the brothers.

verses.en: Long time therefore abode they speaking boldly in the Lord, which gave testimony unto the word of his grace, and granted signs and wonders to be done by their hands.
verses.pt: Eles, entretanto, se demoraram ali por muito tempo, falando ousadamente acerca do Senhor, o qual dava testemunho à palavra da sua graça, concedendo que por suas mãos se fizessem sinais e prodígios.
verses.en_web: Therefore they stayed there a long time, speaking boldly in the Lord, who testified to the word of his grace, granting signs and wonders to be done by their hands.
verses.en_bbe: So they kept there for a long time, taking heart in the Lord, who gave witness to the word of his grace by causing signs and wonders to be done by their hands.

verses.en: But the multitude of the city was divided: and part held with the Jews, and part with the apostles.
verses.pt: E se dividiu o povo da cidade; uns eram pelos judeus, e outros pelos apóstolos.
verses.en_web: But the multitude of the city was divided. Part sided with the Jews, and part with the apostles.
verses.en_bbe: But there was a division among the people of the town; some were on the side of the Jews and some on the side of the Apostles.

verses.en: And when there was an assault made both of the Gentiles, and also of the Jews with their rulers, to use them despitefully, and to stone them,
verses.pt: E, havendo um motim tanto dos gentios como dos judeus, juntamente com as suas autoridades, para os ultrajarem e apedrejarem,
verses.en_web: When some of both the Gentiles and the Jews, with their rulers, made a violent attempt to mistreat and stone them,
verses.en_bbe: And when a violent attempt was made by the Gentiles and the Jews, with their rulers, to make an attack on them and have them stoned,

verses.en: They were ware of it, and fled unto Lystra and Derbe, cities of Lycaonia, and unto the region that lieth round about:
verses.pt: eles, sabendo-o, fugiram para Listra e Derbe, cidades da Licaônia, e a região circunvizinha;
verses.en_web: they became aware of it, and fled to the cities of Lycaonia, Lystra, Derbe, and the surrounding region.
verses.en_bbe: Having got news of it, they went in flight to the towns of Lycaonia, Lystra, and Derbe, and the country round about:

verses.en: And there they preached the gospel.
verses.pt: e ali pregavam o evangelho.
verses.en_web: There they preached the Good News.
verses.en_bbe: And went on preaching the good news there.

verses.en: And there sat a certain man at Lystra, impotent in his feet, being a cripple from his mother’s womb, who never had walked:
verses.pt: Em Listra estava sentado um homem aleijado dos pés, coxo de nascença e que nunca tinha andado.
verses.en_web: At Lystra a certain man sat, impotent in his feet, a cripple from his mother’s womb, who never had walked.
verses.en_bbe: And at Lystra there was a certain man, who from birth had been without the use of his feet, never having had the power of walking.

verses.en: The same heard Paul speak: who stedfastly beholding him, and perceiving that he had faith to be healed,
verses.pt: Este ouvia falar Paulo, que, fitando nele os olhos e vendo que tinha fé para ser curado,
verses.en_web: He was listening to Paul speaking, who, fastening eyes on him, and seeing that he had faith to be made whole,
verses.en_bbe: This man was giving ear to the preaching of Paul, who, looking at him, and seeing that he had faith to be made well,

verses.en: Said with a loud voice, Stand upright on thy feet. And he leaped and walked.
verses.pt: disse em alta voz: Levanta-te direito sobre os teus pés. E ele saltou, e andava.
verses.en_web: said with a loud voice, “Stand upright on your feet!” He leaped up and walked.
verses.en_bbe: Said in a loud voice, Get up on your feet. And, jumping up, he went walking about.

verses.en: And when the people saw what Paul had done, they lifted up their voices, saying in the speech of Lycaonia, The gods are come down to us in the likeness of men.
verses.pt: As multidões, vendo o que Paulo fizera, levantaram a voz, dizendo em língua licaônica: Fizeram-se os deuses semelhantes aos homens e desceram até nós.
verses.en_web: When the multitude saw what Paul had done, they lifted up their voice, saying in the language of Lycaonia, “The gods have come down to us in the likeness of men!”
verses.en_bbe: And when the people saw what Paul had done, they said in a loud voice, in the language of Lycaonia, The gods have come down to us in the form of men.

verses.en: And they called Barnabas, Jupiter; and Paul, Mercurius, because he was the chief speaker.
verses.pt: A Barnabé chamavam Júpiter e a Paulo, Mercúrio, porque era ele o que dirigia a palavra.
verses.en_web: They called Barnabas “Jupiter”, and Paul “Mercury”, because he was the chief speaker.
verses.en_bbe: And they gave the name of Jupiter to Barnabas, and to Paul that of Mercury, because he was the chief talker.

verses.en: Then the priest of Jupiter, which was before their city, brought oxen and garlands unto the gates, and would have done sacrifice with the people.
verses.pt: O sacerdote de Júpiter, cujo templo estava em frente da cidade, trouxe para as portas touros e grinaldas e, juntamente com as multidões, queria oferecer-lhes sacrifícios.
verses.en_web: The priest of Jupiter, whose temple was in front of their city, brought oxen and garlands to the gates, and would have made a sacrifice along with the multitudes.
verses.en_bbe: And the priest of the image of Jupiter, which was before the town, took oxen and flowers to the doors of the town, and was about to make an offering with the people.

verses.en: Which when the apostles, Barnabas and Paul, heard of, they rent their clothes, and ran in among the people, crying out,
verses.pt: Quando, porém, os apóstolos Barnabé e Paulo ouviram isto, rasgaram as suas vestes e saltaram para o meio da multidão, clamando
verses.en_web: But when the apostles, Barnabas and Paul, heard of it, they tore their clothes, and sprang into the multitude, crying out,
verses.en_bbe: But when this came to the ears of the Apostles, Paul and Barnabas, they went running out among the people, parting their clothing, and crying out,

verses.en: And saying, Sirs, why do ye these things? We also are men of like passions with you, and preach unto you that ye should turn from these vanities unto the living God, which made heaven, and earth, and the sea, and all things that are therein:
verses.pt: e dizendo: Senhores, por que fazeis estas coisas? Nós também somos homens, de natureza semelhante à vossa, e vos anunciamos o evangelho para que destas práticas vãs vos convertais ao Deus vivo, que fez o céu, a terra, o mar, e tudo quanto há neles;
verses.en_web: “Men, why are you doing these things? We also are men of like passions with you, and bring you good news, that you should turn from these vain things to the living God, who made the sky, the earth, the sea, and all that is in them;
verses.en_bbe: Good people, why are you doing these things? We are men with the same feelings as you, and we give you the good news so that you may be turned away from these foolish things to the living God, who made the heaven and the earth and the sea and all things in them:

verses.en: Who in times past suffered all nations to walk in their own ways.
verses.pt: o qual nos tempos passados permitiu que todas as nações andassem nos seus próprios caminhos.
verses.en_web: who in the generations gone by allowed all the nations to walk in their own ways.
verses.en_bbe: Who in the past let all nations go in the ways which seemed good to them.

verses.en: Nevertheless he left not himself without witness, in that he did good, and gave us rain from heaven, and fruitful seasons, filling our hearts with food and gladness.
verses.pt: Contudo não deixou de dar testemunho de si mesmo, fazendo o bem, dando-vos chuvas do céu e estações frutíferas, enchendo-vos de mantimento, e de alegria os vossos corações.
verses.en_web: Yet he didn’t leave himself without witness, in that he did good and gave you rains from the sky and fruitful seasons, filling our hearts with food and gladness.”
verses.en_bbe: But he was not without witness, because he did good, and gave you rain from heaven and times of fruit, making your hearts full of food and joy.

verses.en: And with these sayings scarce restrained they the people, that they had not done sacrifice unto them.
verses.pt: E dizendo isto, com dificuldade impediram as multidões de lhes oferecerem sacrifícios.
verses.en_web: Even saying these things, they hardly stopped the multitudes from making a sacrifice to them.
verses.en_bbe: And even with these words, it was hard for them to keep the people from making an offering to them.

verses.en: And there came thither certain Jews from Antioch and Iconium, who persuaded the people, and, having stoned Paul, drew him out of the city, supposing he had been dead.
verses.pt: Sobrevieram, porém, judeus de Antioquia e de Icônio e, havendo persuadido as multidões, apedrejaram a Paulo, e arrastaram-no para fora da cidade, cuidando que estava morto.
verses.en_web: But some Jews from Antioch and Iconium came there, and having persuaded the multitudes, they stoned Paul, and dragged him out of the city, supposing that he was dead.
verses.en_bbe: But some Jews came to that place from Antioch and Iconium, and got control over the people; and after stoning Paul, they had him pulled out of the town, taking him for dead.

verses.en: Howbeit, as the disciples stood round about him, he rose up, and came into the city: and the next day he departed with Barnabas to Derbe.
verses.pt: Mas quando os discípulos o rodearam, ele se levantou e entrou na cidade. No dia seguinte partiu com Barnabé para Derbe.
verses.en_web: But as the disciples stood around him, he rose up, and entered into the city. On the next day he went out with Barnabas to Derbe.
verses.en_bbe: But when the disciples came round him, he got up and went into the town: and the day after he went away with Barnabas to Derbe.

verses.en: And when they had preached the gospel to that city, and had taught many, they returned again to Lystra, and to Iconium, and Antioch,
verses.pt: E, tendo anunciado o evangelho naquela cidade e feito muitos discípulos, voltaram para Listra, Icônio e Antioquia,
verses.en_web: When they had preached the Good News to that city, and had made many disciples, they returned to Lystra, Iconium, and Antioch,
verses.en_bbe: And having made a number of disciples through the preaching of the good news in that town, they went back to Lystra and Iconium and Antioch,

verses.en: Confirming the souls of the disciples, and exhorting them to continue in the faith, and that we must through much tribulation enter into the kingdom of God.
verses.pt: confirmando as almas dos discípulos, exortando-os a perseverarem na fé, dizendo que por muitas tribulações nos é necessário entrar no reino de Deus.
verses.en_web: confirming the souls of the disciples, exhorting them to continue in the faith, and that through many afflictions we must enter into God’s Kingdom.
verses.en_bbe: Making strong the souls of the disciples, saying to them that they were to keep the faith, and that we have to go through troubles of all sorts to come into the kingdom of God.

verses.en: And when they had ordained them elders in every church, and had prayed with fasting, they commended them to the Lord, on whom they believed.
verses.pt: E, havendo-lhes feito eleger anciãos em cada igreja e orado com jejuns, os encomendaram ao Senhor em quem haviam crido.
verses.en_web: When they had appointed elders for them in every assembly, and had prayed with fasting, they commended them to the Lord, on whom they had believed.
verses.en_bbe: And when they had made selection of some to be rulers in every church, and had given themselves to prayer and kept themselves from food, they put them into the care of the Lord in whom they had faith.

verses.en: And after they had passed throughout Pisidia, they came to Pamphylia.
verses.pt: Atravessando então a Pisídia, chegaram à Panfília.
verses.en_web: They passed through Pisidia, and came to Pamphylia.
verses.en_bbe: And they went through Pisidia and came to Pamphylia.

verses.en: And when they had preached the word in Perga, they went down into Attalia:
verses.pt: E, tendo anunciado a palavra em Perge, desceram a Atália.
verses.en_web: When they had spoken the word in Perga, they went down to Attalia.
verses.en_bbe: And, after preaching the word in Perga, they went down to Attalia;

verses.en: And thence sailed to Antioch, from whence they had been recommended to the grace of God for the work which they fulfilled.
verses.pt: E dali navegaram para Antioquia, donde tinham sido encomendados à graça de Deus para a obra que acabavam de cumprir.
verses.en_web: From there they sailed to Antioch, from where they had been committed to the grace of God for the work which they had fulfilled.
verses.en_bbe: And from there they went by ship to Antioch, where they had been handed over to the grace of God for the work which they had not done.

verses.en: And when they were come, and had gathered the church together, they rehearsed all that God had done with them, and how he had opened the door of faith unto the Gentiles.
verses.pt: Quando chegaram e reuniram a igreja, relataram tudo quanto Deus fizera por meio deles, e como abrira aos gentios a porta da fé.
verses.en_web: When they had arrived, and had gathered the assembly together, they reported all the things that God had done with them, and that he had opened a door of faith to the nations.
verses.en_bbe: And when they came there, and had got the church together, they gave them an account of all the things which God had done through them, and how he had made open a door of faith to the Gentiles.

verses.en: And there they abode long time with the disciples.
verses.pt: E ficaram ali não pouco tempo, com os discípulos.
verses.en_web: They stayed there with the disciples for a long time.
verses.en_bbe: And they were with the disciples there for a long time.
